dedupe_keys.name: voies ferrees nommees bd topo republique isogeo

description: Voies ferrées nommées [BD TOPO®] - République Isogeo is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Definition of the IGN: Complex object related to objects Railway section that constitutes a route or a railway Named, tourist or not. Selection: All tourist railways are included. All rail bikes are retained. LGVs are also named. Depending on local partnerships, urban transport lines can also be named. Coverage: FR. Its keywords include national, voies ferrées touristiques, lgv, lignes de transport urbains, république isogeo, transports. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
